intro_zh: 本課學習不規則複數名詞，例如 tooth→teeth、foot→feet、eye→eyes，並練習說 two eyes、two ears、my teeth 等表達。
can_do: 能正確說出 tooth→teeth、foot→feet、eye→eyes 等不規則複數名詞。
能用顏色和形狀的單字描述圖片或物件。
能在句子中使用 and、but、because 連接兩個子句。

sentences.en: Lily stands in the corner of the room holding a silver balloon.
sentences.zh: 莉莉站在房間的角落裡，手裡拿著一個銀色的氣球。

sentences.en: She looks at her wide eyes and narrow nose in the mirror.
sentences.zh: 她看著鏡子裡自己寬寬的眼睛和窄窄的鼻子。

sentences.en: Her two eyes are bright, and her two ears hear the soft music.
sentences.zh: 她的兩隻眼睛很亮，兩隻耳朵聽見輕柔的音樂。

sentences.en: She touches her head, feeling her thick hair and warm neck.
sentences.zh: 她觸摸自己的頭，感覺濃濃的頭髮和溫暖的脖子。

sentences.en: Her mouth smiles, showing her white teeth, but she remembers to brush them.
sentences.zh: 她的嘴巴笑著，露出白白的牙齒，但她記得要刷牙。

sentences.en: She counts her fingers and toes, noting she has ten fingers and ten toes.
sentences.zh: 她數著手指和腳趾，發現自己有十根手指和十個腳趾。

sentences.en: She picks up a dark puzzle piece from the wide package on the table.
sentences.zh: 她從桌上寬闊的包裹裡拿起一塊深色的拼圖塊。

sentences.en: The puzzle shows a narrow path leading to a bright balloon in the dark sky.
sentences.zh: 這張拼圖顯示一條窄窄的小路，通往暗黑天空裡的一個亮色氣球。

sentences.en: She feels happy because the puzzle is thick and the balloon is silver.
sentences.zh: 她感到開心，因為拼圖很厚，氣球是銀色的。

sentences.en: She moves her shoulders, feeling her strong body and checking her teeth for any cracks.
sentences.zh: 她擺動肩膀，感覺自己身體強壯，並檢查牙齒有沒有裂縫。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① 不規則複數對照表
grammar_points.explain_zh: 不規則複數名詞不遵守 -s 規則，必須特別記憶。常見的身體部位如 tooth→teeth、foot→feet、eye→eyes 就是例子。

grammar_points.title_zh: ② 身體部位成雙成對時一定要用複數
grammar_points.explain_zh: 當談論身體上成對出現的部位（眼睛、耳朵、腳、手等）時，必須使用複數形式，否則會聽起來不自然。

examples.en: She washes her feet every night.
He brushes his teeth after meals.

lines.en: I have two feet and I like to jump.
lines.zh: 我有兩隻腳，我很喜歡跳。

lines.en: I brush my teeth every day.
We need two eyes to see the puzzle.
lines.zh: 我們需要兩隻眼睛才能看拼圖。

sentences.en: I have two eyes and I see the blue sky.
sentences.zh: 我有兩隻眼睛，我看見藍天。

sentences.en: She washes her feet after playing soccer.
He brushes his teeth before bedtime.
We need two feet to ride a bicycle.
sentences.zh: 我們需要兩隻腳才能騎腳踏車。

sentences.en: The artist draws two eyes on the mask.
sentences.zh: 畫家在面具上畫兩隻眼睛。

sentences.en: The dentist checks our teeth twice a year.
sentences.zh: 牙醫一年檢查兩次我們的牙齒。

sentences.en: Children need two eyes to read books.
sentences.zh: 孩子們需要兩隻眼睛才能讀書。

grammar: 不照 -s 規則的複數名詞：tooth→teeth、foot→feet、eye→eyes 這類成對身體部位的說法。

mcq.q: The ______ is in the corner. (包裝)

fill.q: She ____ dark hair.（她有深色的頭髮）
The cat is ____ the table.（貓在桌子上）
We ____ to school every day.（我們每天去學校）
My brother ____ apples.（我哥哥喜歡蘋果）
These are my ____ .（這些是我的眼睛）
His ____ hurt every morning.（他每天早上牙齒都疼）
The balloon is ____ .（氣球是銀色的）
Put the ____ on the shelf.（請把盒子放在架子上）

translate.ans: Put the puzzle in the corner.

unscramble.q: the / corner / . / is / The / balloon / in
unscramble.ans: The balloon is in the corner.
